tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// khams bde dri ba'i nyams dbyangs bzhugs// ༄༅// rje bla ma rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud// gnas skabs kyi lo rgyus bshad tsam na// bdag las kyi 'brel ba mang lags pas// nang nub tu phrad kyang khams bde 'dri// yul gzhan du phyin kyang khams so 'dri// yul gzhan nas log kyang khams so 'dri// khams so bde na dga' lags te// khams bde ba'i rten 'brel nyung bar gda'// sgyu ma'i lus la nad gzhi mang*// brjod pa'i ngag la 'dzar 'dzer mang*// gsal ba'i sems la sdug bsngal mang*// yul chags sdang gnyis kyis lus sems phrogs// rnam rtog gi las la zin dus med// de 'khor bar skyes pas nyes pa yin// 'khor ba las thar na dga' lags te// 'khor ba las thar pa'i rten 'brel nyung*// dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs la// skye med stong pa yin mod kyang*// 'khrul pa'i bag chags mthug pa dang*// dngos 'dzin rtsad nas ma chod pas// khams gsum 'khor ba'i khong stong du// dug lnga dug gsum gyi 'tshub ma langs// las ngan sna tshogs kyi bud shing la// sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyi me chen 'bar// gnyug ma rang sems kyi sdong po tshig /byang chub kyi myu gu thal bar btang*// rigs drug sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo de// mgal me bzhin du rgyun du 'khor// skye rga na 'chi'i dpyangs thag la// dus yang nas yang du 'ju yin gda'// thar dus med pa'i brtson dong na// rang sems bcings pa'i btson re sdug /thar pa'i dus med snying re rje// snying re rje ste bya thabs med// bya thabs yod de byed mkhan med// e ma'o 'gro ba nyon re mongs// dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi mgur i thi// //sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// rje bla mas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bdag dben par bsdad nas bsam mno btang*// da ci yi bsam mno 'khrul nas 'dug /bdag mi bde ma mchis bde mor gda'// dal 'byor rnyed dka' thob ste bde// theg chen gyi chos dang mjal te bde// yang dag gi bla ma bsten te bde// gsang sngags kyi chos dang phrad de bde// rgyud tshul bzhin du smin par bgyis te bde// dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrungs te bde// lam rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor bsgoms te bde// zab mo'i spyod pa bsgrubs te bde// yul snang bas sems la gnod pa med// yul snying po med de brdzun par 'dug

/gzugs me long gyi gzugs brnyan 'dra ba la// zhen pa brtsams kyang snying po med// yul gsum kyang de dang 'dra bar 'dug /sgra thos tshad brag ca 'dra ba la// chags sdang brtsams kyang snying po med// ci bsams kyang sgyu mar blo thag chod// sgyu ma'i ngang la bde bar 'dug /sgyu ma btsal bas brjod du med// brjod bral gyi ngang la bde mor 'dug /'khor ba btsal kyang ma rnyed pa// de mya ngan las 'das pa'i rang bzhin yin// gnyis med kyi ngang la bde mor 'dug /sdug bsngal btsal kyang ma rnyed pa// bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin yin// zung 'jug gi ngang la bde mor 'dug /'khor ba spang du med pa la// spang blo ma skyes rnal 'byor pa// sangs rgyas bsgrub tu med pa la// bsgrub blo ma skyes rnal 'byor pa// 'khor 'das med par go ba de// 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba yin// dbyer med kyi ngang la bde mor gda'// 'di ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor pas// bsgrub rgyu med kyang bsgrub la brtson// bsgom rgyu med kyang bsgom la brtson// bsrung rgyu med kyang dam tshig bsrung*// de ltar shes na bde ste mchis// mi bdag kyang de ga'i ngang la gda'// bu khyod kyang de ga'i ngang la zhog /thob med byang chub thob nas mchis// bsgrub rgyu med pa'i sangs rgyas de// rang gi sems la yod pa yin// blo mi bde ma mchis bde mor mchis// rje btsun gyi man ngag dam pa 'di// ye shes rdo rjes bskul nas kyang*// bdag gis 'bad de bris pa yin// bla med byang chub thob par shog /lcags mo yos lo dbyar zla 'bring po la/ dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis khams bsangs la mdzad do// //bdag cag dam pa'i lha chos byed pa la// rgyab rten du dkon mchog gis chog par byung*// sdod sa ru spyil bus chog par byung*// sdod grogs su yi dam gyis chog par byung*// smra grogs su bzlas pas chog par byung*// 'jigs grogs su yi dam gyis chog par byung*// chog pa drug rje btsun rin po che'i gsung ngo*// i thi//
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
